title: neotorularia aculeolata
intro: Neotorularia aculeolata, commonly known as the prickly cabbage or hairy rocket, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family. It is known for its edible leaves, which are rich in nutrients and offer several health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help protect against chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Neotorularia aculeolata include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral activities, making it a potential remedy for various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
